categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches src/wallet/walletdb.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.cpp, carries the Wallet label, and adds database records tracking wallet upgrade features.
categories.rationale: Records upgrade metadata needed in advance of future automatic wallet upgrades to safely detect downgrade-upgrade cycles. As noted in the description, this tracking metadata must be deployed in versions prior to introducing new automatic upgrades, directly unblocking PR #33034 and subsequent wallet migration improvements.
